assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated BANANA illustration for a BAIT game card, a new subject using the attached bomb emblem only as a visual style reference. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no scenery, no ground, no cast-shadow plane, no frame, no card border, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Illustration only; typography will be drawn in the app.
